text:
The adverse possession period began when the tenant subjectively came to believe he no longer had permission to possess the cottage, not when the widow died or when he stopped paying rent alone. The lease survived her death, so his initial occupancy was permissive, and it became hostile only once he repudiated the tenancy in his own mind. This revises my earlier answer, which wrongly treated the rent stoppage as the start date and so put the limitations period too early.

CONFIDENCE: 70
